title: policy/v2
description: policy.json at the graph root (F15-R3; F23-R9; D-32 v3.33, D-35): as policy/v1, the visible switch for the steward rule, plus `steward_admission`, the switch for how a steward is admitted: `open`, a record merges unattended and is marked self-admitted; `reviewed`, a curator merges it and is named in it. An absent file, or a policy/v1 file, means `open`. Curator-owned (path role `policy`); flipped by one pull request. Versioned, never edited (D-34).

enforced.description: Whether an open-track target with no active steward refuses claims (F15-R4; D-6 v3.17).

since.description: The day the current state was set.

evidence.description: What justified the current state: for enforcement, the calibration record (Stages v3.17).

steward_admission.description: How a steward record is admitted (D-32 v3.33).
